name: The Dunes Golf Links
editorNote: The Dunes is Tony Cashmore's public 18-hole championship links course in Rye, set among rolling dunes. The separate Cups Course is a shorter nine-hole links layout suited to a quick round or a mixed-experience group. The club also has a driving range and on-site Links Lodge accommodation. Check the club's current course conditions, green fees and live tee times before you travel.
